name: rpg-factory
description: Development workflow orchestration for the UnityIndie RPG MMO workspace (server, client, Netcode, UnityDots, UIToolkit): Factory Core and a generic delivery skill (two-level flow, cross-model review, QA tiers, plan/verdict/gate for any repository) plus 14 specialised skills, deterministic routing with advisory execution modes, module registry with cross-repo contracts and pin watchers, a check runner with tree-bound evidence (STALE/NOT_RUN), derived cross-repo status, status/route/check/doctor commands, and advisory guards for git, GitHub and file tools (they never block). Tags and releases only with explicit user authorization.

interface.shortDescription: Route, validate, and review RPG workspace changes
